theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_ga_local_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (g : Euclid m → Euclid k) (D : Set (Euclid m)) (t : ℝ) (w₀ : Euclid m), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g D → 1 < t → w₀ ∈ D → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball w₀ r ⊆ D ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclid m), MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ ball w₀ r → μHE[m] ((fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) '' B) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t * ∫⁻ w in B, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).det)) ∧ ∫⁻ w in B, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).det)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t * μHE[m] ((fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) '' B)
